patterns.name: Oversized display type with an offset asset
patterns.mechanism: A headline at clamp(3.5rem, 9vw, 9rem) takes 7/12 columns, with the supporting visual offset in the remaining columns. The subline stays at or under 60ch, there is one primary CTA, and the headline enters line by line on a stagger (60ms, 600ms, ease-out-expo).

patterns.name: A single interactive object as the brand hook
patterns.mechanism: One object reacts to the cursor or scroll: tilt, magnetic pull or a shader blob. It's lazy-loaded after LCP, and a static poster is shown until it loads. Under reduced motion it stays static.

patterns.name: Proof-first company hero
patterns.mechanism: The headline states the outcome, not the category. Directly under it are proof chips: a metric, a logo row, or a rating. There are two CTAs, a primary and a quieter secondary. A product or work visual sits below the fold edge to invite scrolling.
